about:
HC Group Auto Parts Supply LLC operates from Columbia, South Carolina. The company was founded in 2005 as a family-owned business, identifying itself as a local South Carolina supplier.

The company supplies a complete line of premium aftermarket auto body parts, sourcing from vendors such as LKQ Keystone and other top manufacturers. Its product lineup includes parts from manufacturers that advertise 'Made in USA' origins, including a bumper supplier described as the world's largest and a leading lighting and mirror provider. It maintains stock for immediate pickup and offers delivery to body shops and businesses across South Carolina and Georgia.

Its customers include collision repair centers and auto body shops throughout the Midlands, Lowcountry, and Upstate regions of South Carolina, as well as the Augusta, Georgia area. Delivery routes cover cities such as Columbia, Lexington, Greenville, Charleston, and North Augusta, among others listed in its service regions.

The company emphasizes premium quality aftermarket parts, same-day availability for in-stock items, delivery service, and competitive pricing, positioning itself as a reliable source for repair shops seeking OEM-equivalent components.
